'''Monica''' is an NPC and the Chief Administrator among the Gardeners of the [[Black Shores]].
==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Monica}}
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After completing [[To the Shore's End]])
:'''Monica:''' {{Rover}}, hello again! Thank you so much for your help.
:{{DIcon}} Just doing my duty as a Bloom Bearer.
:{{DIcon}} All for the Black Shores.
:'''Monica:''' I promised to give you a proper welcome as our new member after this crisis.
:'''Monica:''' But I've still got a lot of follow-up tasks. Sorry about that.
:{{DIcon}} That's very kind of you, Monica.
:{{DIcon}} We can do it next time.
:You notice Monica frowning, clearly worried about something.
:'''Monica:''' Is something bothering you?
:'''Monica:''' Ha, I guess it's all over my face, isn't it? It's a bit tricky, actually.
:'''Monica:''' The issue with Tethys is resolved, so the corrupted data in Black Shores should have been cleared as well.
:'''Monica:''' But the infected members aren't showing any signs of recovery.
:'''Monica:''' In other words, the source of the infection is gone, but their condition isn't improving.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like phantom pain.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like a cognitive issue.
:'''Monica:''' The medical team thinks so, too.
:'''Monica:''' The [[Shorekeeper]]'s been helping with their treatment. I just hope they'll get better soon.
:{{DIcon}} They will. Don't worry.
:{{DIcon}} Let me know if I can help.
:'''Monica:''' Thank you, {{Rover}}.
{{Dialogue End}}
